title: Barter measurement and fairness standard
summary: Prevents barter from becoming exploitation by defining units, rules, witnesses, and protected needs.
content: Barter measurement and fairness standard is a practical offline routine for local economy. Define local units for water, grain, meals, fuel, batteries, repair time, transport, and caregiving. Separate emergency aid from barter so desperate people are not forced into unfair survival trades. Post common exchange ranges and review them publicly as scarcity changes. Use a witness for high-value trades and write both sides of the agreement. Protect children, elderly people, sick people, and displaced people from coercive trades.
